behaviors.name: Parallax
behaviors.intent: Slide with the camera at a fraction of its speed for depth.
behaviors.source:
behavior Parallax
  var home = (0, 0, 0)
  var cam0 = 0
  on start
    home = self.position
    cam0 = find("Game Camera").position.x
  end
  on tick
    let cam = find("Game Camera").position.x
    self.position.x = home.x + (cam - cam0) * self.factor
  end
end

behaviors.name: Squish
behaviors.intent: Bounce in place with a jelly squish so it looks alive.
behaviors.source:
behavior Squish
  var base = 0
  on start
    base = self.position.y
  end
  on tick
    let t = sin(time * 6 + self.id)
    self.scale = (1.0 + t * 0.12, 0.8 - t * 0.12, 0.8)
    self.position.y = base - t * 0.06
  end
end

behaviors.name: Collectible
behaviors.intent: Spin in place; when the player touches it, pop and count a coin.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  rotate self by (0, 240 * dt, 0)
  let p = find("Player")
  if exists(p) and distance(self, p) < 0.9 then
    emit "coin" to p
    destroy self
  end
end

behaviors.name: Runner
behaviors.intent: Run right at a steady pace and hop on a rhythm, landing back on the grass.
behaviors.source:
behavior Runner
  var vy = 0
  var coins = 0
  on tick
    move self by (5.0 * dt, 0, 0)
    vy = vy - 22.0 * dt
    self.position.y = max(0.7, self.position.y + vy * dt)
    every 1.4 seconds
      vy = 9.0
    end
    -- squash & stretch while airborne
    let s = 1.1 + clamp(vy * 0.02, -0.12, 0.12)
    self.scale = (1.1 - (s - 1.1), s, 1.1)
  end
  on event "coin"
    coins = coins + 1
  end
end

behaviors.name: Follow
behaviors.intent: Follow the player smoothly, keeping them a little left of center.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let p = find("Player")
  if exists(p) then
    self.position.x = lerp(self.position.x, p.position.x + 4, 0.08)
  end
end
